Question 5
?

For which of the following vector fields is f(x,y)=xln⁡(y2+1) a potential function?

a
2xyy2+1i+ln⁡(y2+1)j
b
ln⁡(y2+1)i+2xyy2+1j
c
 ln⁡(y2+1)i−xyy2+1j
d
 ln⁡(y2+1)i+xyy2+1j
e
xyy2+1i−ln⁡(y2+1)j
Submit
